records.name: Azphel
notes: 2-source+ : five boards on global, Azphel at 45 (Metabot guide + Metabot assassin board data + GameWith planner; Skycoach gives same levels 20/30/40/45).

requires.note: The whole Daevanion window opens with unlock:daevanion (its `at`: "Urgent Pursuit" turned in, owner screen). One gate, defined once there; every plan node on this board inherits it on top of its own board level.

records.name: Nezekan
notes: 2-source+ : five boards on global, Azphel at 45 (Metabot guide + Metabot assassin board data + GameWith planner; Skycoach gives same levels 20/30/40/45).

Not on global by 45. Metabot (guide + assassin board data) and GameWith list exactly 5 boards with no Ariel; Skycoach: 'Ariel (PvE) and Azphel (PvP): Level 45 … Ariel is currently absent on Global'. MeinMMO and gameplay.tips name Ariel (gameplay.tips also Marchutan, Yustiel) without unlock levels, likely KR info. => tip 'Five boards … Azphel (45)' is right; Ahead row 'Ariel and Azphel boards' is wrong (use 'Azphel board (PvP)').
Board nodes add +1 'above the normal cap' (Metabot skill pages); none says whether they count toward specialty unlocks.

requires.note: The whole Daevanion window opens with unlock:daevanion (its `at`: "Urgent Pursuit" turned in, owner screen). One gate, defined once there; every plan node on this board inherits it on top of its own board level.
